records.subject: KINES
records.title: Foundations of Physics for Sport and Exercise
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 103 with a C or better, or ALEKS math placement score of 40% or higher, or credit for or concurrent enrollment in MATH 105, 106, 108, 140, 171, 201, 202, STAT 205, or 212.
records.description: Basic concepts of physics, including general motion, linear and angular acceleration, contact, stress-strain, gravity, energy, heat, torque, fluids, levers, optics and electrical fields; emphasis on the relationship between these concepts and the physiology and practice of sport and physical activity.
